sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Customer;
SELECT Name FROM Artist ORDER BY AlbumId DESC LIMIT 1;
SELECT FirstName, LastName, COUNT(*) AS numberOfCustomers FROM Employee INNER JOIN Customer ON Employee.SupportRepId = Customer.SupportRepId GROUP BY FirstName, LastName;

SELECT ArtistId, COUNT(DISTINCT GenreId) AS distinct_genres
FROM Artist
JOIN Genre ON Artist.ArtistId = Genre.ArtistId
GROUP BY ArtistId;

SELECT InvoiceDate, Total, Month(InvoiceDate) AS Month
FROM Invoice
GROUP BY InvoiceDate, Month(InvoiceDate)
ORDER BY Month(InvoiceDate) ASC;

SELECT year, population
FROM country_stats
GROUP BY iso3, year
ORDER BY year;

SELECT income_group, gdp_usd
FROM countries
JOIN country_stats ON countries.iso3 = country_stats.iso3
WHERE year = 2023
ORDER BY gdp_usd DESC;

SELECT iso3
FROM countries
WHERE iso3 IN (
    SELECT iso3
    FROM country_stats
    WHERE year = 2010 AND internet_users_pct < 10
    AND iso3 IN (
        SELECT iso3
        FROM country_stats
        WHERE year = 2023 AND internet_users_pct > 50
    )
)
SELECT AVG(flipper_length_mm) AS average_flipper_length FROM penguins;
SELECT MAX(MPG) FROM cars_data WHERE Cylinders = 8 AND Year < 1980;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM employee;

SELECT Paragraph_ID, Paragraph_Text
FROM Paragraphs
WHERE Document_ID = (
    SELECT Document_ID
    FROM Documents
    WHERE Document_Name = 'Welcome to NY'
);

SELECT AVG(loser_age), AVG(winner_age) AS average_ages
FROM matches;
SELECT semester_name FROM Semesters WHERE semester_id NOT IN (SELECT semester_id FROM Student_Enrolment)
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM poker_player;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM countrylanguage WHERE Language IN ('English', 'Dutch');
SELECT name, COUNT(*) AS num_friends FROM Highschooler GROUP BY name;

SELECT first_name
FROM Owners
WHERE first_name NOT IN (
    SELECT first_name
    FROM Dogs
    WHERE name = ?
)
